items.ex_en: I don't have much free time.

items.ex: Nel tempo libero leggo e cucino.
items.ex_en: In my free time I read and cook.

items.en: what do you do in your free time? (informal)
items.ex: Cosa fai nel tempo libero? — Vado in palestra.
items.ex_en: What do you do in your free time? — I go to the gym.
items.notes: formal: cosa fa nel tempo libero?

items.ex: Il fine settimana dormo fino a tardi.
items.ex_en: On weekends I sleep in.
items.notes: also il weekend; plural i fine settimana (invariable)

items.ex: Qual è il tuo hobby preferito?
items.ex_en: What's your favorite hobby?
items.notes: m.; h is silent; plural gli hobby (invariable)

items.ex_en: Do you play sports? / Do you work out?
items.notes: fare sport = to play sports, exercise; plural gli sport (invariable)

items.ex: In Italia il calcio è lo sport più popolare.
items.ex_en: In Italy soccer is the most popular sport.
items.notes: also means a kick

items.ex: Gioco a calcio il sabato con gli amici.
items.ex_en: I play soccer on Saturdays with friends.
items.notes: giocare a + sport/game: gioco a tennis, gioco a carte

items.ex_en: The game is on tonight.
The gym opens at six.

items.ex: Vado in palestra tre volte a settimana.
items.ex_en: I go to the gym three times a week.
items.notes: no article: in palestra

items.ex: Mi piace correre la mattina presto.
items.ex_en: I like running early in the morning.
items.notes: mi piace + infinitive = I like (doing)

items.ex_en: Do you like reading? — Yes, a lot!
items.notes: formal: Le piace leggere?

items.ex_en: I listen to music every day.

items.ex: Suono la chitarra da dieci anni.
items.ex_en: I've played guitar for ten years.
items.notes: instruments use suonare, not giocare

items.ex_en: I read one book a month.
Shall we watch a movie tonight?
items.notes: plural i film (invariable)

items.ex: Il cinema è vicino a casa mia.
items.ex_en: The movie theater is near my place.
items.notes: m. despite -a; plural i cinema (invariable)

items.en: shall we go to the movies?
items.ex_en: Shall we go to the movies tonight? — Gladly!
Shall we take a walk downtown?
items.notes: fare una passeggiata = to take a walk; the evening stroll is la passeggiata

items.ex_en: I love cooking for my friends.
Traveling is my passion.

items.ex: Il sabato sera andiamo a ballare.
items.ex_en: On Saturday nights we go dancing.

items.en: what are you doing this weekend? (informal)
items.ex: Cosa fai questo fine settimana? — Vado al mare.
items.ex_en: What are you doing this weekend? — I'm going to the beach.

items.ex: Qual è la tua squadra preferita?
items.ex_en: What's your favorite team?

items.en: which team do you root for? (informal)
items.ex: Per che squadra tifi? — Per la Roma.
items.ex_en: Which team do you root for? — Roma.
items.notes: tifare per = to root for, support (a team)

items.ex_en: This song is beautiful.
Tonight we're going to a concert.
I've been studying guitar for two years.
My daughter plays the piano.
items.notes: often shortened to il piano

items.ex: La lettura è la mia passione.
items.ex_en: Reading is my passion.

items.ex: Sto guardando una nuova serie TV.
items.ex_en: I'm watching a new TV show.
items.notes: TV is read tivù; plural le serie TV (invariable)

items.ex: Al museo c'è una mostra su Caravaggio.
items.ex_en: There's a Caravaggio exhibition at the museum.

items.ex: La fotografia è il mio hobby.
items.ex_en: Photography is my hobby.
items.notes: a photo is usually la foto (f., plural le foto)

items.ex: Il nuoto è uno sport completo.
items.ex_en: Swimming is a full-body sport.

items.ex: La piscina è aperta fino alle nove.
items.ex_en: The pool is open until nine.
items.notes: many Italian pools require a swim cap (la cuffia)

items.ex_en: Do you play tennis?
Running relaxes me.
Tomorrow we're going on a hike in the mountains.
items.notes: f.; plural le escursioni

items.ex_en: I'm taking a cooking class.
items.notes: also a main street: il corso

items.ex_en: I do yoga every morning.
items.notes: no article: fare yoga

items.ex_en: My son plays video games.
items.notes: plural i videogiochi

items.ex: Lo sci è il mio sport preferito.
items.ex_en: Skiing is my favorite sport.
items.notes: plural gli sci (invariable); sciare = to ski

items.ex_en: Do you play chess?
items.notes: always plural

items.ex_en: In the evening we play cards.
I like modern painting.
I'm reading a mystery novel.
items.notes: un giallo = a mystery/crime novel

items.ex_en: I'm a Napoli fan.
items.notes: f.: la tifosa

items.ex_en: My mother loves gardening.

items.ex: Domenica andiamo alla sagra del tartufo.
items.ex_en: On Sunday we're going to the truffle festival.
items.notes: village festivals celebrating a local food, common in summer and fall

items.en: I'm really into…, I'm passionate about… (said by a man)
items.ex_en: I'm really into photography.
items.notes: a woman says: sono appassionata di…
